## Vocabulary

- **self**: External sorter spill files and the _tmp directory (15/4)

## How it works

- [statement] File-based external sorting writes sorted data to temporary storage under dbpath/_tmp; MongoDB's index-build implementation documents local, unreplicated sorter files there when the memory budget is reached. (medium confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/index_builds/README.md · keywords: External sorter spill files and the _tmp directory · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/index-creation/
- [statement] An in-memory storage engine does not by itself guarantee that aggregation execution avoids disk. SERVER-36388 describes an external sorter that can spill independently of the storage engine; a separate firsthand May 2, 2025 Percona In-Memory 5.0.22 test reports local-drive I/O when allowDiskUse enabled an aggregation that otherwise failed. These are historical observations, not verification of every current engine/version. (medium confidence) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-36388 · keywords: External sorter spill files and the _tmp directory · also: https://forums.percona.com/t/how-does-percona-inmemory-handle-aggregations-that-require-allowdiskuse/37630
- [statement] A separate October 2022 Windows 10 report records errno:2 No such file or directory for _tmp/extsort-time-sorter.2 under a user-profile dbPath. Moving the data location reportedly allowed the aggregation to finish; the thread does not establish a general root cause. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/community/forums/t/windows-10-mongod-dont-find-files-in-tmp-when-data-directory-is-subdirectory-of-c-user/195823 · keywords: External sorter spill files and the _tmp directory
- [statement] For two-phase index builds, each replica independently scans its local collection, and its external sorter spills to local, unreplicated files under dbpath/_tmp when its memory budget is reached. This statement is scoped to the two-phase implementation described in the master-branch README, not every index-build mode. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-31) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/index_builds/README.md · keywords: External sorter spill files and the _tmp directory
- [statement] MongoDB 8.0 documents query-pipeline temporary sort files as lasting for the pipeline execution. Long-running sorts can consume instance storage, and temporary-file growth can trigger Atlas storage auto-scaling. This lifecycle statement concerns executing pipelines, not resumable index-build artifacts. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.0/reference/operator/aggregation/sort/ · keywords: External sorter spill files and the _tmp directory

## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] Query-sort and index-build memory budgets are separate: the cursor documentation describes the 100 MB non-indexed sort threshold, while the index-build documentation describes maxIndexBuildMemoryUsageMegabytes and a 200 MB self-hosted default shared across indexes in one createIndexes command. Do not use the query-sort threshold to size every _tmp producer. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/method/cursor.allowDiskUse.md · keywords: External sorter spill files and the _tmp directory · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/index-creation/

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] The dbpath/_tmp directory is not exclusive to query sorting. Query aggregation error reports show external temporary files there, and the index-build manual independently specifies the same directory for index-build spill files. A filename or directory-size increase alone cannot identify the responsible query. (medium confidence) — https://stackoverflow.com/questions/68112645/why-does-mongodb-return-a-errno24-too-many-open-files-error · keywords: External sorter spill files and the _tmp directory · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/index-creation/, https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/index_builds/README.md
- [statement] A June 24, 2021 firsthand Windows Server 2016 report shows MongoDB 4.4 failing to open _tmp/extsort-doc-group.463 with errno:24 Too many open files during aggregation. The author reports success after reducing the queried interval from seven days to three. This establishes a historical file-handle failure case, not a general Windows tuning prescription or a current unresolved defect. (low confidence) — https://stackoverflow.com/questions/68112645/why-does-mongodb-return-a-errno24-too-many-open-files-error · keywords: External sorter spill files and the _tmp directory

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] The master-branch implementation README also describes primary-driven index builds that spill sorted keys into a replicated storage-engine table, unlike the local file spills of two-phase builds. Therefore, the presence of an external sorter does not universally imply loose files under _tmp. The README alone does not establish which released versions enable this path. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-31) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/index_builds/README.md · keywords: External sorter spill files and the _tmp directory
- [statement] MongoDB documents a 100 MB memory threshold for spill-capable aggregation stages and large non-indexed query sorts. Starting in MongoDB 6.0, allowDiskUseByDefault controls default spilling; an individual command can permit or prohibit temporary disk writes with allowDiskUse. Disallowing spilling can make an oversized operation fail rather than cap its disk footprint while continuing. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/method/cursor.allowDiskUse.md · keywords: External sorter spill files and the _tmp directory · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/aggregation-pipeline-limits.md

## Facts and statements

- [statement] allowDiskUse grants permission to spill; it does not force a spill. The cursor method has no effect on sorts satisfied by an index or sorts below the documented memory threshold. Inspect whether an explicit SORT is present before attributing temporary storage to a query sort. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/method/cursor.allowDiskUse.md · keywords: External sorter spill files and the _tmp directory · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.0/reference/operator/aggregation/sort/
- [statement] MongoDB 8.0's serverStatus documentation scopes indexBulkBuilder.filesOpenedForExternalSort and filesClosedForExternalSort to external-sorter file handles used by index bulk building; it says to combine them to determine open handles. These are not per-query spill-file counts. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.0/reference/command/serverstatus/ · keywords: External sorter spill files and the _tmp directory
- [statement] Do not equate every increment of metrics.query.sort.spillToDisk with one logical spill. The 8.0 manual describes disk writes, and SERVER-125498 explains that chunk-buffer flushes inflated the counter relative to logical spills; the issue lists fixes in 9.1.0 release candidates. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-31) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.0/reference/command/serverstatus/ · keywords: External sorter spill files and the _tmp directory · also: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-125498
- [statement] Do not assume every sorter artifact is disposable immediately after shutdown: implementation notes preserve external-sorter state for eligible resumable index builds, and SERVER-50644 records encryption-key work specifically intended to permit temporary-file reuse during recovery. (medium confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/index_builds/README.md · keywords: External sorter spill files and the _tmp directory · also: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-50644
- [statement] Do not assume every file under _tmp is disposable after a restart: resumable index builds persist external-sorter state for recovery, and supported clean-shutdown cases recover the index build from a checkpoint. Cleanup decisions must distinguish query spills from retained index-build state. (medium confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/index_builds/README.md · keywords: External sorter spill files and the _tmp directory · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/index-creation/
